ValidationRule.description: Blocks discounts on instalment deals for individual customers; Fleet-Corporate is the only exception and still needs approval (US-25). Skipped when a request is being marked Invalidated (KAN-92).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Opportunity__r.Payment_Mode__c, 'Instalment' ), Opportunity__r.Account.RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'Fleet_Corporate', NOT( ISPICKVAL( Current_Step__c, 'Invalidated' ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Discounts are not permitted on instalment deals for individual customers. Only Fleet-Corporate accounts may discount an instalment opportunity, and only through the normal approval process.
